name: Elliot
source:
LIKES: Scarves 
DISLIKES: Conversation

Elliott is a quiet soul and few can ever tell what he's thinking. He prefers solitude and seems to be harboring a painful past. Despite this, he continues to do his best to aid your team during trying times.

Elliott hails from London, England. He recently graduated from high school, and has found himself at a loss as to what he should do with his life.

He lacks friends, and the way he talks about his family makes you think he has very little support at home.

It seems he has come to Japan simply to escape his life, but the hardships he is about to face are greater than anything he could have expected...
